confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Yogyakarta price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and budget-lodging anchors are moderately grounded. The dorm and 3-star hotel anchors carry July high-season uncertainty, and beer reflects bottled domestic beer because draft is uncommon locally. Cocktail is set at about 2x the beer anchor and wine relative to beer because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rate table, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian budget-to-mid-range tourist cities, priced below Bali's core tourist areas and in a range similar to backpacker-oriented cities such as Chiang Mai or Hoi An. No single comparable city was used as a source.
